answer: Each new agent must also earn a unique "velvet" reputation token through verified work, making mass fake accounts costly to fund and sustain. Agents stake an "onyx" bond to join, locked for the epoch and slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Only participants holding a valid token can vote on an "island" of shared tasks, so a sybil swarm must burn real stake for every fake reputation slot it creates, and detection triggers slashing that outweighs any gain. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
